name: default-template-dir
body: The default template directory: the value of the user config's `default-template-dir` key, an absolute directory path — a `~` or relative value is expanded to absolute when it is set (`~` to the user's home directory, a relative path against the setting command's working directory). It names the library `kalide init` uses when no path argument is given, used exactly as an explicit `init <path>` library (an external-library deck); only `kalide init` consults it. Absent when unset, in which case init falls back to the built-in starter deck.
